rule: Only established published layers enter the screen. New composites are allowed only after each component demonstrates an independently required capability.

architectures.name: input-only GRU
architectures.bias: finite-dimensional causal memory with learned gates

architectures.name: CausalConv1d + GRU
architectures.bias: local multiscale causal pattern extraction before recurrence
architectures.precondition: new receptive field or contract must be a distinct hypothesis

architectures.name: LSTM
architectures.bias: separate gated cell and exposed hidden state
architectures.required_capability: mixed short and long credit assignment

architectures.name: predicted-state-feedback GRU
architectures.information_contract: events plus own previous predicted state; teacher state only at initialization

architectures.name: causal TCN
architectures.bias: finite causal receptive field with parallel multiscale filters
architectures.precondition: must solve fast-slow microtask without subthreshold spill
architectures.information_contract: events or residual history as preregistered

architectures.name: S4
architectures.bias: long convolution generated by a structured linear state-space model
architectures.required_capability: long memory with stable fast-slow response

architectures.name: Mamba
architectures.precondition: S4 result must show selection, not generic capacity, is missing

architectures.name: CfC
architectures.required_capability: mixed time constants without numerical solver

architectures.name: Liquid Time-Constant network
architectures.precondition: solver cost and tolerance counted as treatment

architectures.name: Neural ODE
architectures.bias: learned autonomous/nonautonomous vector field integrated by a solver
architectures.precondition: event discontinuities represented as controls/jumps rather than hidden by interpolation

architectures.name: Neural CDE
architectures.bias: continuous hidden dynamics driven by an interpolated control path
architectures.precondition: only if continuous/irregular input timing becomes part of the contract

architectures.name: message-passing neural network
architectures.bias: shared local updates and edge-mediated compartment coupling
architectures.information_contract: local states/events plus fixed compartment graph

architectures.name: message passing + standard recurrent cell
architectures.bias: local spatial coupling composed with temporal memory
architectures.precondition: both graph and recurrence components pass independent controls
architectures.information_contract: local events and recurrent node states

architectures.name: switching mixture of experts
architectures.precondition: DG-02 must show separable regime plus a capable fast expert
architectures.information_contract: same causal information for gate and experts

architectures.name: standard slow-fast multirate composition
architectures.bias: different update rates for distinct temporal scales
architectures.precondition: measured timescale separation and matched update budget

architectures.name: historical ConvLSTM XL
architectures.bias: local temporal filters plus gated recurrence
architectures.precondition: not directly comparable to current input-only 61-state contract

architectures.name: historical receptor-GRU mosaic
architectures.bias: ontology-aligned local recurrent transitions with global backbone
architectures.precondition: requires fresh controls under current four-compartment contract
